facts.statement: WB_RST_I is asynchronous reset input for UART core
After reset receiver and transmitter shift registers are cleared
facts.quote: The receiver and transmitter shift registers are cleared

facts.statement: After reset Divisor Latch register is set to 0
facts.quote: The Divisor Latch register is set to 0.

facts.statement: After reset Line Control Register is 8 bits no parity 1 stop bit
facts.quote: The Line Control Register is set to communication of 8 bits of data, no parity, 1

facts.statement: After reset all interrupts are disabled in Interrupt Enable Register
facts.quote: All interrupts are disabled in the Interrupt Enable Register.

step_implementations.question: Which common clock UVC starts stable fixed-period clock on wb_clk_i with symbolic period P_fixed held fixed through reset with no dynamic switching? No clock agent in shared_agents, base clock_generate from t_clk_seq not yet defined, and nominal P_fixed undocumented with only labels 3.6864 for 115200 bps and 1258Mhz for 1200 bps and Max Min Resolution unresolved.

What testbench stabilization limit in observed wb_clk_i edges defines stable clock before reset, and which common clock monitor samples edges? Stabilization count is testbench choice not documented DUT timing.

Which common reset UVC asserts reset on wb_rst_i with period-scaled duration, and what is documented active level polarity and minimum assert cycles? Excerpt states only Asynchronous Reset with no polarity and no cycles; quick-test-only active-high 10-cycle hold is testbench choice not documented requirement.
Which common monitors sample wb_rst_i assertion and wb_clk_i edges to track reset duration to symbolic P_fixed with no DUT timing requirement? Requires observation only before any configuration.
Which common reset UVC deasserts reset on wb_rst_i to complementary inactive level, and what is documented inactive level? Excerpt states only Asynchronous Reset with no polarity.

What documented deassert-to-configuration delay defines post-reset stabilization on wb_clk_i edges before init_config_sequence, and which common coordination orders cleanup to configuration stage after t_clk_seq clock_generate and reset_drive? Delay undocumented.
What testbench operational value for TEST_TIMEOUT_CYCLES aborts bring-up if reset not completed, with ordering after t_clk_seq? Timeout is testbench limit not DUT timing.
